Q1. Which exact part of this repository should change? Choose one and include the workflow/script/file name if you know it.
Choices:
A. A workflow file (for example under `.github/workflows/`) — give the exact filename/path (RECOMMENDED)
B. A script or prompt file (for example under `scripts/` or `prompts/`) — give the exact filename/path (RECOMMENDED)
C. A docs/guidance file — give the exact filename/path
D. I do not know the file yet — name the workflow/job/step or output that is wrong
Q2. What concrete problem are you trying to improve? Choose one and add a one-sentence description of the current bad behavior.
Choices:
A. A workflow fails, flakes, or gets stuck (RECOMMENDED)
B. The automation is too slow, noisy, or expensive
C. The docs/prompt/output text is confusing or incorrect
D. Another problem — describe it (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What should planning use as the acceptance example for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow run URL or run number (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific GitHub issue or PR number that shows the problem
C. A specific file/output with the exact before/after behavior
D. No existing artifact — write the exact before/after expectation (RECOMMENDED)
